description: Check whether a stay is free for a date range, or which time slots a tour or experience has on a date. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; for stays endDate is the check-out day. Returns available (true/false, or null with a reason when it can't be confirmed here, e.g. hotels where a room type is chosen on the page). Use get_quote for the price.
name: check_availability
title: Check availability
